step1_analysis.description: A differential amplifier stage with cross-coupled PMOS and NMOS loads. The cross-coupling provides positive feedback (negative resistance), which is typically used either to enhance the Q-factor in a continuous-time bandpass filter (Gm-C) or to act as a high-speed continuous-time comparator/latch in a sigma-delta modulator.

paper_reference.title: A 1-MHz-Bandwidth Second-Order Continuous-Time Quadrature Bandpass Sigma–Delta Modulator for Low-IF Radio Receivers

power.description: Total DC power consumption of the stage

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming Vgs=0.9V for the input pair, Id = 0.5 * 270uA/V^2 * (5/0.5) * (0.9-0.42)^2 = 311uA per side. Total current ~622uA. Power = 1.8V * 622uA = 1.12mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 21.8mW for the entire ADC. This single stage consumes a small fraction of the total power.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = Gm * Rout. Gm ~ 1.3mS. Rout is boosted by the cross-coupled negative resistance, potentially reaching 10k-50k ohms. Gain ~ 13 to 65 V/V (22 to 36 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical gain for a single-stage pre-amplifier or Q-enhanced Gm cell.

sky130_expected.calculation: Bandwidth = 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * Cout). With Rout ~ 20k and Cout ~ 50fF, BW ~ 160 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The amplifier must be fast enough to process the 100 MHz clock frequency reported in the paper.

t_delay.description: Propagation delay from input to output

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay is roughly Cout / Gm. 50fF / 1.3mS ~ 38ps. Adding internal parasitic delays brings it to ~50-100ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the order of magnitude of the 110ps delay reported in the paper for the comparator/latch.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for measuring DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, and transient delay of the amplifier/comparator stage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Continuous-Time Amplifier / Comparator Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VVINP VINP 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 PULSE(0.8 1.0 1n 100p 100p 5n 10n)
VVINN VINN 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 PULSE(1.0 0.8 1n 100p 100p 5n 10n)

XM6 V1OUTP V1OUTP N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM3 N0 V1OUTP N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM7 V1OUTN V1OUTP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM4 N2 V1OUTN N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM9 V1OUTN V1OUTP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 V1OUTP V1OUTN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM1 N7 VINP VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N6 VINN VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM5 V1OUTN V1OUTP N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM8 V1OUTP V1OUTP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 100 1k 10G
let gain_mag = vmag(v(V1OUTP) - v(V1OUTN))
let gain_db = 20 * log10(gain_mag)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1k
meas ac max_gain max gain_mag
let gain_3db = max_gain / 1.414
meas ac bw_3db when gain_mag=gain_3db fall=1

tran 10p 10n
meas tran t_delay trig v(VINP) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(V1OUTP) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran vout_p_max max v(V1OUTP)
meas tran vout_p_min min v(V1OUTP)
meas tran vout_n_max max v(V1OUTN)
meas tran vout_n_min min v(V1OUTN)
quit
.endc
.end
